items.title: New attacks in Hormuz and Saudi test nerves as war's spread worsens oil disruption
items.title_zh: 霍尔木兹新袭与沙特遇袭叠压：周末再测油市神经
items.summary_zh: 路透9月13日综述：英国海事安保机构UKMTO称霍尔木兹海峡有船只遭抛射物击中起火；沙特南部吉赞省传出胡塞跨境袭击民居与清真寺画面；交易商预期周一开盘油价再涨。延布库存若撑不过数日，全球供应或再失约4%。

quotes.author: Reuters
quotes.en: New strikes on Saudi Arabia and on ships in the Gulf tested nerves in the Middle East on Sunday, after an attack on a Saudi oil pipeline and an advance by Yemen's Houthis threatened to worsen the wartime disruption to global energy supplies.
quotes.zh: 周日，沙特境内与海湾船只再遭打击，测试中东神经；此前沙特输油管遇袭与也门胡塞推进，已威胁加剧战时全球能源供应中断。

items.title: LG denies TV spying claims, says tracking and snooping concerns 'not true'
items.title_zh: LG否认电视间谍指控：称追踪窃听疑虑“不属实”
items.summary_zh: Tom's Hardware报道LG强硬否认“间谍电视”调查；HN热议ACR音频指纹与“不连续录制”话术。逾600赞。

quotes.author: rpdillon
quotes.en:
LG's statement:
> ACR uses audio fingerprinting technology using the TV’s internal audio processor (not a speaker) to identify content and does not collect screenshots, screen recordings, video recordings, voice recordings, or other audio recordings from the TV.
So they are claiming that ACR is done entirely through audio processing, and no visual data from the screen itself is used? That...doesn't seem plausible.
This paper from 2024 investigated both Samsung and LG and found that they both capture screen images for ACR, and send the resulting hash (not the raw content) back to the manufacturer for identification.
quotes.zh: LG声明称ACR用电视内部音频处理器做音频指纹识别内容，不采集截屏/录像/录音。那他们是在说ACR完全靠音频、不用屏幕画面？这……不太可信。2024年论文调查三星与LG，发现两者都会为ACR抓屏并回传哈希。

quotes.author: aeternum
quotes.en: Note that their statement could also be true if they record 99% of the time. We need to start calling companies out for meaningless weasel statements like "We don't record continuously". The majority of the problem is also simply the ability to record. Putting a remote control listening hardware on a device that runs a plethora of 3rd party apps and with full connection to the internet means that even if LG isn't controlling that mic, someone else will be.
quotes.zh: 注意：就算他们99%时间在录，这声明仍可能字面为真。该点名“我们不连续录制”这类空话了。更大问题是具备录音能力本身——遥控监听硬件塞进跑一堆第三方应用、全时联网的设备，就算LG不控麦，别人也会。

items.title: Saudi pipeline outage threatens loss of 4% of global oil supply
items.title_zh: 沙特东西向管线停运：数日内或抹掉全球约4%原油供应
items.summary_zh: CNA转述路透9月13日：东西向管线周五停运后，延布库存仅够维持出口5–7天；该线此前日转运约400万桶绕开霍尔木兹。修复估时从数日至五六周不等，沙特官方尚未给出完整损毁与复运时间表。

quotes.author: CNA / Reuters
quotes.en: Saudi Arabia will run out of oil stocks for exports if it does not restart its major pipeline to the Red Sea within days, leading to a loss of up to 4 per cent of global supply, Saudi oil buyers and traders said.
quotes.zh: 沙特石油买家与交易商称，若数日内无法重启通往红海的主要管线，出口库存将耗尽，全球供应或损失多达4%。

items.title: IKEA made a mod for Skyrim [video]
items.title_zh: 宜家给上古卷轴做了个模组（视频）
items.summary_zh: 宜家发布Skyrim模组广告片，评论区迅速翻出其对独立游戏The Store is Closed的施压旧案，并拿Chex Quest类比品牌游戏改造。近590赞。

quotes.author: Hackbraten
quotes.en: IKEA bullied the developer of the indie game The Store is Closed into gutting the whole game. It's a shame how people can even acknowledge, let alone applaud IKEA's "funny" gaming-related ad after their successful meddling with SCP folklore, not to speak of the chilling effect their actions may have had on indie gaming.
quotes.zh: 宜家曾逼独立游戏《The Store is Closed》开发者把游戏掏空。人们居然还能给宜家这则“搞笑”游戏广告点赞，实在可耻——更别提对独立游戏圈的寒蝉效应。

quotes.author: nkrisc
quotes.en:
The concept reminds of Chex Quest, a Doom total conversion based on Chex, the cereal brand. I loved playing it when I was 8 or so.
https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chex_Quest
quotes.zh: 这概念让人想起Chex Quest——基于麦片品牌Chex的Doom全面改装版。我大概八岁时超爱玩。

items.title: Houthis' Yemen advance leaves Gulf states with uncomfortable choice
items.title_zh: 胡塞拿下红海沿岸后，海湾国家面临“吞痛还是谈伊朗”
items.summary_zh: 路透安卡拉分析：胡塞控制曼德海峡口战略岛屿，给伊朗打开第二条施压点；海湾官员称特朗普拒绝对胡塞直接动手后，与德黑兰并行外交正从选项变成自保刚需。原定周一阿曼霍尔木兹会谈亦成风向标。

quotes.author: Reuters
quotes.en: The Houthi capture of Yemen's Red Sea coastline is reshaping the balance of power in the Gulf, strengthening Iran's hand and confronting Saudi Arabia and its neighbours with a difficult choice: absorb mounting costs or seek accommodation with Tehran.
quotes.zh: 胡塞夺取也门红海沿岸正在重塑海湾力量平衡、强化伊朗手中的牌，并迫使沙特及邻国二选一：吞下不断上升的代价，或寻求与德黑兰妥协。

items.title: Homebrew 7.0.0
items.title_zh: Homebrew 7.0.0发布：更快安装、更强沙箱与原生App
items.summary_zh: Homebrew维护者宣布7.0.0：更快安装升级、更强沙箱、原生macOS应用、内置漏洞检查；结束10.15支持，Intel Mac降为Tier 3。约500赞。

quotes.author: mikemcquaid
quotes.en: Today, I'm proud to announce Homebrew 7.0.0. The most significant changes since 6.0.0 are faster installations and upgrades, stronger sandboxing, a native macOS app, built-in vulnerability checks and an advisory database, the end of macOS 10.15 support and Intel Macs moving to Tier 3 (announced last year).
quotes.zh: 今天很高兴宣布Homebrew 7.0.0。自6.0.0以来最重要的变化：更快安装与升级、更强沙箱、原生macOS应用、内置漏洞检查与公告库，结束对macOS 10.15支持，Intel Mac降为Tier 3（去年已预告）。

quotes.author: simonw
quotes.en: TIL Homebrew has its own sandbox mechanism - looks like it's built around their own sandbox-exec wrapper, at least on macOS.
quotes.zh: 今日得知Homebrew自有沙箱机制——至少在macOS上看似包了一层自己的sandbox-exec封装。

items.title: Red Sea nations watch as Houthis seize Bab al-Mandeb strait
items.title_zh: 红海沿岸国家注视：胡塞已实质扼住曼德海峡
items.summary_zh: 半岛电视台9月13日：胡塞拿下穆哈与佩里姆（马云）后，距非洲海岸仅约20公里，实质上控扼全球约12%贸易、11%海运石油所经的曼德海峡。过去24小时逾2000人逃往吉布提；埃及苏伊士收入阴影再起，厄立特里亚地缘角色抬升。

quotes.author: Al Jazeera
quotes.en: Houthi forces are now positioned just 20 kilometres (12 miles) from the African coast and essentially control the strategically significant Bab al-Mandeb strait, a chokepoint for Red Sea maritime traffic.
quotes.zh: 胡塞部队现距非洲海岸仅约20公里，实质上控制了具有战略意义的曼德海峡——红海航运咽喉。

items.title: LG Says We're Fake News [video]
items.title_zh: LG说我们是假新闻（视频）：“我们拥有这块玻璃”引炸
items.summary_zh: 跟进LG电视争议的视频帖；评论痛批“卖给你硬件却仍声称拥有这块玻璃”的商业模式，以及无法卸载的预装应用。逾300赞。

quotes.author: dgellow
quotes.en: This „we own the glass“ idea is completely insane. How does an industry degenerate to the point where they consider acceptable to base their business model on owning part of the product they sell you?
quotes.zh: “我们拥有这块玻璃”的想法完全疯了。一个行业怎么堕落到认为：把商业模式建立在继续拥有已卖给你的产品的一部分上，是可以接受的？

quotes.author: hadlock
quotes.en: I deeply regret buying my LG. Originally the plan was to never connect it to wifi, and use an external device but my wife was too excited to try out whatever features. Unfortunately we can't sell the TV for anywhere what we paid for it new so we're stuck with it for another ~7-10 years. New "apps" keep showing up on the main screen, which I have to "delete" from the main screen once a month or so.
quotes.zh: 深深后悔买了LG。本打算永不连Wi‑Fi、外接盒子，但家人想试用功能。二手卖不回原价，只能再熬7–10年。主屏还不断冒出新“应用”，每月得藏一次。

items.title: Vessel struck in Strait of Hormuz near Qeshm, UKMTO and Iran report
items.title_zh: 霍尔木兹盖什姆附近船只遭袭：UKMTO与伊朗各报伤亡
items.summary_zh: CNN：伊朗国家媒体称一艘伊朗商船周六深夜在盖什姆岛附近遇袭，1死4伤；UKMTO亦报告霍尔木兹有船遭抛射物击中起火、船员撤离。事件发生在原定阿曼讨论霍尔木兹通行安排的前夕。

quotes.author: CNN
quotes.en: Iranian state media has claimed an Iranian commercial vessel was struck in the Strait of Hormuz late Saturday, killing one person, amid an ongoing battle between the US and Iran for control over the crucial energy chokepoint.
quotes.zh: 伊朗国家媒体称，一艘伊朗商船周六深夜在霍尔木兹海峡遇袭，造成1人死亡；美伊仍在争夺这一关键能源咽喉的控制权。

items.title: I Added a Non-Wi-Fi Mitsubishi AC to Home Assistant
items.title_zh: 给无Wi‑Fi三菱空调接入Home Assistant
items.summary_zh: 作者记录把非联网三菱空调接入HA的硬件与ESPHome路径；评论区贡献刷写器、零件清单与PID控温吐槽。约160赞。

quotes.author: akifbayram
quotes.en: I've been working on a similar setup using the M5Stack NanoC6 and AtomS3 Lite, and put together a parts list and wiring guide on my site. I also built a web flasher with firmware configured for those boards, so you can install directly from your browser without any fiddling.
quotes.zh: 我也在用M5Stack NanoC6和AtomS3 Lite做类似方案，网站上放了零件与接线指南，还做了网页刷写器，可直接从浏览器安装固件。

quotes.author: acyou
quotes.en: These mini split inverter units seem to be good for +/- 1 C, but the 2 C swing can feel quite substantial. PID control seems to be lacking overall, the control laws seem to be more basic. In particular, my unit waits until temperature deviation from setpoint exceeds 1C before cycling on.
quotes.zh: 这类变频分体机大概能做到±1°C，但2°C摆动体感很明显。整体缺少像样的PID，控制律偏基础——我这台要偏离设定超过1°C才启动。
